UPDATE twitch_partners
        SET status = $1,
            departnered_at = NULL,
            admin_archived_at = NULL,
            technical_pause_reason = NULL,
            manual_partner_opt_out = 0,
            raid_bot_enabled = CASE WHEN raid_admin_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
            partnered_at = $2
        WHERE id = $3
